reference_text: The lantern shone along the empty road. We would reach the bridge before dawn. A quiet voice asked whether we should wait.

narrator.description: An adult woman with a calm warm alto, clear articulation and restrained narration.

anonymous.description: A neutral adult voice with a clear middle register, distinct from the narrator.

keeper.description: An adult man with a warm low baritone and patient conversational phrasing.
